ALL Dive.id ORDER BY id: priority=HIGH AND EXISTS canonical image with valid laser and no SpeciesLabel(project_id NOT NULL, superseded=false). No cluster gate, no needs_reprocess term.
all species labels of dive with superseded=false (INCLUDES sentinels, NOT canonical-filtered), ORDER BY image_id; 404 when empty (SDK -> None)
DISTINCT project_id where NOT NULL and superseded=false; incomplete=true adds completed false/NULL (web landing page). Must be registered before /labels/species/{image_id}.
first non-superseded species row of image (arbitrary if several)
upsert: only fields present in body are written; id None + project_id sent -> natural key (image, project); project_id absent -> sole row for image or 409; id of another image -> 409
non-superseded row by label_studio_task_id; 404 if none (sync skips)
per (kind='species', project) last_synced_at cursor; already ported generically in v2 label_sync_store
raise needs_reprocess on canonical-image, superseded=false species rows (default incomplete only) -> dive re-enters stage 2; JPEGs redrawn at same keys, LS tasks untouched
lower flag; checksums scopes to those canonical frames; unfiltered on superseded when clearing; 0 not 404 when nothing
clusters of dive+data_source with image_ids from mapping table; NO ORDER BY on clusters or members (order is DB-incidental)
insert one cluster + mappings; images looked up by id IN (...) with no dive check; non-atomic across calls
written only by species sync; uncertain exact route spellings — verify before porting

contracts: PreprocessSpeciesImagesInput (libs/fishsense-shared/src/fishsense_shared/preprocess_contracts.py:97-119): dive_id:int, clusters: List[List[str checksum]], camera_matrix: 3x3 floats, distortion_coefficients: List[float], cluster_members: Optional[List[List[SpeciesClusterMember]]]
SpeciesClusterMember (preprocess_contracts.py:80-94): checksum, cluster_index (1-based, in WHOLE PREDICTION cluster), cluster_size (whole cluster)

PreprocessSpeciesImageInput (data-worker internal, preprocess_species_images_workflow.py:29-37): checksum, cluster_index, cluster_size, output_folder='preprocess_groups_jpeg', camera_matrix, distortion_coefficients

v2 note: `clusters` + Optional `cluster_members` exist only for v1 rolling-deploy compatibility; a fresh v2 contract (fishsense_services_contracts/species.py) can carry just members with capture_id + object keys, since v2 names its own queues
ClearReprocessFlagsInput (api-worker internal): dive_id, checksums Optional[List[str]] (None = whole dive)
UpdateDiveImageGroupsResult (dataclass, workflow return): skipped_already_grouped, new_clusters_created, species_labels_seen

Object keys: scratch bucket raw/{checksum}.ORF (api-worker PUT, data-worker GET, deleted after child); labels bucket {labels_prefix}/preprocess_groups_jpeg/{checksum}.JPG (durable, overwritten on redraw); LS task data image/img = s3://{labels_bucket}/{labels_prefix}/preprocess_groups_jpeg/{checksum}.JPG (populate_utils.build_image_url), also stored in species_labels.image_url

LS task data shape: {image, img, taken: ISO-8601 text, image_id: v1 int}; predictions: [{model_version:'species-csv-import-2026-09', result:[{from_name, to_name:'image', type:'taxonomy', value:{taxonomy:[[...]]}}]}]

LS labeling-config control names (load-bearing): grouping ('Part of previous group'/'Not part of current group'), exclude ('Top 3 photos of group'), species taxonomy (leafsOnly), measurable, fishAngles, fishCurve; object 'image' value $image
v2_schema_gaps: dive_frame_cluster_captures (0012) has no member position; v1 has none either (GET clusters has no ORDER BY). 'image i of N' and stage 6.1 'first frame of cluster' need an order: derive ORDER BY captures.captured_at, id in the store, or add a position column. Parity with v1's incidental order is uncertain.

Cluster ORDER is also load-bearing for 6.1 ('Part of previous group' crosses cluster boundaries). v2 ids are random uuids, and persist_prediction_clusters inserts every cluster in one transaction with now(), so created_at/updated_at tie. Order clusters by min(member captured_at).

No dive-to-LS-project mapping. v1 finds a project by title '{name} #{v1 int dive_id} - Species Labeling'. A v2 title built from a uuid would miss every migrated project and create duplicates. Either build titles from dives.v1_id when present, or add a label_studio_projects(tenant_id, dive_id, kind, ls_project_id) table. Decision needed.

species_labels.source is NOT NULL for new rows (CHECK source IS NOT NULL OR v1_id). Decide the value for populate-seeded rows ('human'?), sentinel imports ('import'), and rows whose task carries a prediction ('pre_annotation'?). v1 has no equivalent.

species_labels has ls_labeler_id instead of v1 user_id, and no laser_x/laser_y/laser_label/slate_upside_down. The sync writes the LS id directly, so sync_users is not needed. v1_migration.py:390-394 does not carry those four legacy columns, so historical values are dropped. Confirm that is intended.

v1 Dive.dive_slate_id maps to dives.slate_template_id (slate_templates.name UNIQUE, OK). calibration_targets.name is NOT unique (versioned by valid_from), so the sync must resolve names through the current_calibration_targets view.

No dive_pipeline_status view in v2 (no has_prediction_clusters, dive_images_preprocessed or species_labeling_complete). The Superset/research-views slice owns it, but its predicates must mirror these cohorts.

No object-store module or key contract in v2 yet; captures.raw_object_key exists (0005). The existing JPEG keys under preprocess_groups_jpeg must stay readable, because LS tasks and species_labels.image_url hold them.

Camera intrinsics: v1 uses dive.camera_id -> cameraintrinsics. v2 uses dives.device_id -> current_camera_calibrations (0007), which also has medium/coordinate_frame. The resolver must pick the row v1 would (uncertain whether filtering on medium/frame is needed).
needs_reprocess exists on species_labels (0010). No new column is needed for the flag, but the scoped clear needs captures.checksum joined on canonical captures (available).

gotchas: The overlay i/N is the frame's position in the WHOLE PREDICTION cluster, not in the redrawn subset. Redrawing 3 of 7 as 1/3..3/3 corrupts the same keys silently (preprocess_contracts.py:80-94; test_species_cluster_positions.py).

Eligible frames in no PREDICTION cluster become singleton '1/1' clusters. Never lump them into one synthetic cluster. One orphan keeps the whole LS project an unpublished draft (resolver:159-192; prod dives 442/87/94).

Selector vs resolver mismatch: the selector requires the qualifying image to be IN a PREDICTION cluster (dive_cohort_controller.py:559-574), but the resolver also emits orphans. A dive whose only work is an unflagged orphan is never selected. The selector docstring is stale on this. Mostly latent now that stage 1 clusters every canonical frame.

Resolvers must mirror the selector predicate exactly, including canonical-only and needs_reprocess. Otherwise the dive is selected, resolves to nothing, re-stages ORFs hourly and head-of-line blocks higher-id dives (CLAUDE.md 'Cluster correctness'; prod dives 59/60/439).

When a run resolves no work, lower the flag for the whole dive. On success, clear only the checksums actually dispatched: the child can run 2h and a flag raised meanwhile must survive (parent:64-111).
If CHILD_ALREADY_RUNNING, do NOT clean up raw or clear flags; the running owner does both (parent:89-98).

Preprocess child id 'preprocess-species-{dive_id}' and populate id 'populate-species-{dive_id}' use ALLOW_DUPLICATE, never FAILED_ONLY. Dedup lives inside the activities. FAILED_ONLY stranded late-eligible frames (prod dives 59/439/60).

Stage 2 does not drain on its own work. Its cohort clears only when the +20 populate parent seeds species rows, so firing preprocess N times rebuilds one dive N times (CLAUDE.md ~1186-1194; prod dive 8).
Both cohorts count only non-superseded rows with a project. A superseded row is not evidence of done work; ignoring supersede deadlocked the two cohorts (1,826 images stranded, fixed 2026-07-21).

Sentinel = species row with no LS project. Cohorts, 6.1, and populate's supersede pass must each honour it explicitly. The supersede pass must skip sentinels or it destroys imported judgements (populate:291-299; test_the_supersede_pass_leaves_judgement_sentinels_alone).

A completed or superseded sentinel is refused as a pre-annotation source. A completed sentinel removes its image from population forever, because completed_ids has no project filter (populate:149-164).

Pre-annotations go in predictions, never annotations: sync would write annotations back as human work. build_prediction must round-trip exactly through the sync's _parse_results (test_species_preannotation.py). Emit only leaf paths (>=2 non-empty parts), single-element paths for measurable/fishAngles/fishCurve, and never grouping, exclude, or slate type.
Populate is JPEG-gated. Never seed a species row before the stage-2 JPEG exists, or the image leaves the preprocess cohort with no JPEG forever (populate:48-74).
Publish only when deferred==0, the import is complete, and the project has tasks. Projects are created as drafts so annotators never see a half-filled project (populate:306-327).

Populate retries are bounded (5 attempts, 30s initial) and a retry must reconcile rather than re-import, using the IMPORT_ISSUED heartbeat details. Every heartbeat after the import must carry the marker (_populate.py:25-47; dive 424 reached 23 copies).

LS task order is fixed at import. Feed tasks in capture order: v1 orders labels by image_id and adds 'taken' ISO text plus image_id. v2 has uuids, so order by captured_at, id. Decide what image_id means in new task data.
Per-dive title '{name} #{dive_id} - Species Labeling' is capped at 50 chars by truncating the name, never the '#id' tail. Dive names are not unique. Matching is by title within the workspace.

Sync, content_of_image: prefer a path in SLATE_LASER_CONTENT over path 0, because LS returns sibling paths in click order. The old path-0 read cost 34 rows across 6 dives (sync:68-103; test_species_slate_content_path_order.py).

Sync: 'Slate not in list' must never resolve to a slate. It writes Dive.notes only, only when notes are empty, never priority, and only for dives with no real slate answer this run (sync:146-173, 382-410).
Sync: a Calibration Targets leaf is matched on the whole path, the Ruler is refused (it is validation data), and an unknown name resolves to nothing (taxonomy.calibration_target_leaf).
Sync: the most recent completed annotation wins per dive; a vote with no timestamp never displaces a timestamped one (_reduce_winners 222-243).
Sync: a parsed None keeps the stored value (_apply_parsed). v1's fetch-mutate-PUT clobbers a needs_reprocess raised mid-sync; v2 should use a column-scoped UPDATE as apply_laser_sync already does.
Sync cursor: a fix whose LS updated_at does not move is skipped. Parser fixes need a cursor rewind (CLAUDE.md ~870-900).

6.1 starts a new group at a cluster's first frame unless that frame says 'Part of previous group'. 'Not part of current group' breaks mid-cluster. Frames with no real label are omitted. Prod dive 5: a sentinel split one hogfish into two Fish rows.

6.1 refuses to run when any LABEL_STUDIO cluster exists (v1 has no DELETE). v1 POSTs clusters one at a time, so a failure mid-run leaves a partial set that blocks all re-runs. v2 should persist all-or-nothing under an advisory lock, as persist_prediction_clusters does.
get_species_labels returns sentinels and filters only superseded. It is not canonical-filtered and 404s when empty.

Species XML is load-bearing and pinned by test_species_labeling_config_xml_structure.py and test_species_xml_model_parity.py. A new measurable leaf also needs taxonomy.MEASURABLE_* and views.KNOWN_FISH_MODELS entries.

Overlay parity is byte-for-byte with the notebook (test_stage2_notebook_parity.py): text '{i}/{N}' at (w-350, h-75), HERSHEY_SIMPLEX scale 5, red (0,0,255), thickness 10, LINE_AA, default JPEG quality. Keep the fishsense-core pin.
v2 Temporal names must differ from v1's (PLAN §6.5): queue, workflow-id and schedule-id prefixes. Schedules are created, never updated in place.
